title: 第25章 心若凉了再想暖热可就难了第26章 时光如梭如白驹过隙要珍爱时间
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
姜云天抬眼看了看几女的状态，青鸳、青瑶、小狸已经退出了状态，青莲和青儿还没有。
姜云天青鸳说道：“你看看有没有什么武器可以让我使用，势大力沉的剑或是其它的。”
青鸳道：“我找找看，你等等”
过了一会，青鸳拿出了一个像剑但无锋，但又不是剑的，还有一头有一个柄的像剑的棍子，道：“这个比较重，像是个剑胎，不知道你合不合用。”
这个东西是单独放的，不在武器丹药阵器的任何一个区域内，放在储物戒指的角落里。
青鸳又道：“你要不合意，就自己找吧”
说着就递上姜云天母亲留下的储物戒指。
姜云天接过那个棍子，说道：“戒指你收着，我需要就问你要。”
青鸳心里又是一阵浓浓的感动，心道：“在修行界，即使是师兄弟，亲兄弟，都不会把储物戒指交给别人保管。
道侣更是不可能，而天儿一再要我帮他保管。
看来，他说的一切都听我的，我想怎么样就怎么样的话，是发自己内心的，天儿如此赤诚，我不能辜负他。
只要他想，我可以一直给他生小猴子，只要他要，我定随叫随到，这样的好男人，你还有什么其它的奢望呢，此伟丈夫也。”
姜云天把剑胎拿在手里，仔细感应了一下，这东西确定很重，他再在没有进入元婴，也无法确切进入到内部空间，了解到底是什么。
在手上试了一下，差不多可以用，他想以后就先用这个做为武器修炼破剑术。
姜云天此时还在想的是，以后重要东西先不能自己保管。
亲朋至爱的相关事情，能不让系统和那四个死鬼感知到就不让他们知道。
只有这样，才能最好的保护自己，不能让自己的底牌全亮出来。
这一会青儿和青莲也是睁开眼睛。
看到大家都在看他俩。
青儿先说道“你们都准备好了吗？”

姜云天看着大家：“如果准备好了，大家就开始吧！”
姜云天居中，五女环围四周，以顺时针按照土、金、水、木、火相生之势排开。
大家先后运功，开始修炼，阴阳合神功运转，阴阳鱼开始旋转，一个周天后，大家都能感到，灵气相生，越来越快，而因大家修为不同，保持平衡的是姜云天的主阴阳鱼，为什么大家都能感受到姜云天的是主阴阳鱼呢，是因为大家感觉到不平衡的五行力量会被牵引到姜云天的阴阳鱼里，转换过后又变成等份的五行之气反馈给她们。
她们相互配合，一起全力运功，环环相生，灵力越来越猛，但却很平和。
经过如此修炼了几个时辰，青儿和青莲都感觉自己要突破了，而姜云天更是如此，就主动停了下来。
经过这次修炼，大家对共同修炼都是抱有更大的期待了。
姜云天之所以停下来，是因为上次突破招来天罚之事，他有信心渡过天劫，但天劫异象却会引来不必要窥视。
会带来无尽的麻烦。
所以他主动停了下来。
他又想了一下，道，你们自己运行一下试试。
五女也是相视点头，开始运功，这次没有姜云天从中调和，大家都谨慎起来，经过半个时辰的运行，停了下来。
青鸳笑道：“可以修练，只是不能随自己的修为而畅快运行，只能在着力维持平衡的情况下，才可以运行，比起你在的时候，差了十倍不止，不过也要比单独修炼快3倍以上。”
五女点头。
姜云天也点了点头，突然灵光一闪道：“我把功传给你们，大家先试练一下，然后合练，看看行不行。”
说着，将五行阵功法传给五女，五女开始各自己修练，半个时辰后，大家对于功法运行基本掌握。
content_en:
Jiang Yuntian raised his eyes and looked at the status of the girls. Qingyuan, Qingyao, and Xiaoli had already exited the status, but Qinglian and Qing'er had not yet.
Jiang Yuntian Qingyuan said: "See if there is any weapon I can use, a powerful and heavy sword or something else."
Qingyuan said: "I'll look for it, you wait."
After a while, Qingyuan took out a stick that looked like a sword but had no edge, but was not a sword. There was also a sword-like stick with a handle on one end, and said: "This one is heavier, like a sword embryo. I don't know if it is suitable for you."
This thing is placed alone, not in any area of the weapon elixir array, and placed in the corner of the storage ring.
Qingyuan said again: "If you don't like it, just find it yourself."
With that said, he handed over the storage ring left by Jiang Yuntian's mother.
Jiang Yuntian took the stick and said, "Keep the ring. If I need it, I'll ask you for it."
Qingyuan was deeply moved again and thought: "In the world of cultivation, even brothers and brothers will not give their storage rings to others for safekeeping.
Taoist companions are even more impossible, and Tian'er has repeatedly asked me to keep it for him.
It seems that everything he said listens to me. If I do whatever I want, it comes from my heart. Tian'er is so sincere, I can't let him down.
As long as he wants, I can keep giving birth to little monkeys for him. As long as he wants, I will be at your call. What other extravagant wishes do you have for such a good man? Such a great husband. "
Jiang Yuntian took the sword embryo in his hand and felt it carefully. This thing was definitely very heavy. Even if he didn't enter Yuanying, he couldn't exactly enter the inner space to understand what it was.
He tried it on his hand and found it almost usable. He thought he would use this as a weapon to practice sword breaking in the future.
What Jiang Yuntian was still thinking at this time was that he couldn't keep important things by himself in the future.
Things related to relatives and friends should be kept from the system and the four dead ghosts as long as they don't know about them.
Only in this way can we best protect ourselves and not let all our trump cards be revealed.
At this moment Qing'er and Qinglian also opened their eyes.
I saw everyone looking at them.
Qing'er said first, "Are you all ready?"
Jiang Yuntian looked at everyone: "If you are ready, let's start!"
Jiang Yuntian is in the middle, surrounded by five women, arranged clockwise according to the mutual generation of earth, metal, water, wood and fire.
Everyone moved their skills one after another and began to practice. The yin and yang combined magic skills started to rotate, and the yin and yang fish began to rotate. After a week, everyone could feel that the spiritual energy was interdependent and faster and faster. Because everyone had different cultivation levels, it was Jiang Yuntian's main yin and yang fish that maintained the balance. Why everyone could feel that Jiang Yuntian's was the main yin and yang fish? It was because everyone felt that the unbalanced five elements' power would be pulled into Jiang Yuntian's yin and yang fish, and after conversion, it would become equal parts of the five elements' qi and feed back to them.
They cooperated with each other, worked hard together, and interacted with each other. Their spiritual power became more and more powerful, but they were very peaceful.
After practicing like this for several hours, both Qing'er and Qinglian felt that they were about to break through, and Jiang Yuntian even more so, so they took the initiative to stop.
After this practice, everyone has greater expectations for practicing together.
The reason why Jiang Yuntian stopped was because his last breakthrough resulted in divine punishment. He was confident that he could survive the catastrophe, but the vision of the catastrophe would attract unnecessary prying eyes.
It will bring endless trouble.
So he stopped on his own initiative.
He thought again and said, try running it yourself.
The five girls also looked at each other and nodded, and began to perform their exercises. This time, without Jiang Yuntian to mediate, everyone became cautious. After half an hour of operation, they stopped.
Qingyuan smiled and said: "You can practice, but you can't move freely according to your own cultivation. You can only operate when you focus on maintaining balance. It's more than ten times worse than when you were here, but it's more than three times faster than practicing alone."The fifth girl nodded.
Jiang Yuntian also nodded, and suddenly he had a flash of inspiration and said: "I will pass on the skills to you. Let's try it out first, and then practice together to see if it works."
With that said, he passed on the Five Elements Formation technique to the five girls, and the five girls began to practice on their own. After half an hour, everyone basically mastered the operation of the technique.
